content: Merikɨtsɨ 'Itsahaki kepauka 'ukiratsi matɨa kahaunieretɨ kanayani. Hikɨ kepauka 'Etsahu katiniutanɨ'airieni yuniwe matɨari mieme, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neniwe. 'Etsahu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Tita perayexeiya nepaapa.
'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Pepɨnetsixeiya nepu'ukiratsiri, kwitɨwa nepumɨwe.
Hikɨ yeuta kenemie 'atupi meta 'a'ɨrɨ perapitɨ tixaɨtɨ ketinemi'a mɨtikwaiwa.
Witsi'anekame kenenekawewiri mɨnetsinake hepaɨ, kenene'atɨiri nemikwanikɨ. Hikɨ 'ana Kakaɨyari nepɨtawawirieni 'aixɨa mɨmatsiyurienikɨ nekamɨwetɨkuxi.
Hikɨ Xeweka kanita'enakaitɨni, 'Itsahaki yuniwe 'Etsahu kemɨtikɨhɨawekai, 'ayumieme 'amɨretɨa 'Etsahu yeuta reumiemieka yupaapa hetsiemieme,
Xeweka yuniwe Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Neuxei, 'apaapa nepe'eni 'Etsahu matɨa pɨrekuxatakai, mɨpaɨ pɨreikɨhɨawekai:
ketinemiemie kenenekawewiri tsiha'anekame nemikwanikɨ. Mɨpaɨtsiere pɨrehɨawe kename 'aixɨa 'iyurieni Yawé hɨxie mexi kamɨwe.
Hikɨ keneneu'eni neniwe kenemɨmatitahɨawe, yaketinekaye'a.
Kenemie tsipuri memuyename keniwarahapani yuhutame 'etsimemɨpepe 'aixɨa memɨ'anene nepikawewirieni 'apaapa 'itsari tsiha'anekame minake.
'Ekɨ pepenu'ɨirieni meikwanikɨ mɨpaɨ mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari petawawirieni 'aixɨa mɨmatsiheyurienikɨ kamɨwetɨ 'akuxi.
Perutsɨ Kakuwu yumaama mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Neuxeitsɨ, peru nematsika 'Etsahu kwinimieme pɨreuhuxa neta hawaikɨ.
Xɨka nepaapa netsihemayɨani, pɨretimani kename neti'itaiyane, 'anari peitawawirieni 'axanemɨ'itɨariekakɨ, 'aixɨa nemɨ'itɨariekakɨ pɨkatixaɨ.
Hikɨ maamaya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei nepɨta nehetsie ketiunake mɨkɨ 'axamɨ'ane. 'Ekɨtɨ yaketineuyuri kenemɨmarahɨawe, kenemie kapuratsixi kenenehapaniriemie.
Kakuwu tsipuri kaniwarekuhapani yumaama kani'atɨirieni, mɨkɨ 'itsari kanikawewirieni kemɨtinakekai 'Itsahaki.
Hikɨ Xeweka 'Etsahu kamixaya kaniwayehurieni 'aixɨa mɨ'ane mi'utakai yukiita, mɨkɨ Kakuwu kananakatɨtɨani.
Hikɨta kapuratsixi wanawiyarikɨ mamateya kaniuti'eima, meta kɨipitɨana hakewa mɨkaheuhuxakai,
hikɨ Xeweka Kakuwu yuniwe katiniyetuirieni 'itsari paa mame.
Kakuwu yupaapa hetsɨa nuaka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Nepaapa. 'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwauni: —¿Kemɨ'ane neniwe 'ekɨ peputaine?

Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne 'Etsahu neputaine, 'aniwe mexɨakame. 'Ari nepɨrekawewi kepemɨnerahɨawekai. Kenanukukeka ketineukwa'i tita nemɨremi, 'anari Kakaɨyari pepɨtawawirieni 'aixɨa mɨnetsiyurienikɨ.
Hikɨ 'Itsahaki kanita'iwawiya: —¿Kwitɨwa kuta peremi, neniwe? Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Yawé 'akakaɨyari pɨnetsiheparewi nemeitaxeiyakɨ kwitɨwa.
Hutarieka 'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Ena 'aurawa kenayaka nemetsimayɨani mɨpaɨ nemɨretimanikɨ xɨka 'aku neniwe 'Etsahu peyɨaneni.
Kakuwu 'aurawa kaniuyani paapaya 'imayɨaka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Kakuwu hepaɨ pepɨtiuxaxata, peru mamate 'Etsahu pɨmamateya.
Hikɨ paapaya pɨkaheitima, mamateya muhuxatɨkateikɨ 'Etsahu hepaɨ. Kepaukari Kakaɨyari mɨtawawirienikekai 'aixɨa miyurienikɨ,
tawarita kanita'iwawiya: —¿Yurikɨ 'aku neniwe 'Etsahu petiyɨane? Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Yurikɨ ne nekaniyɨaneni.

Hikɨ paapaya mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Netinatuiri neniwe nemɨtikwanikɨ tita pemɨremi, hikɨ Kakaɨyari nekanitawawiriemɨkɨ 'aixɨa mɨmatsiyurienikɨ. Kakuwu katinekatu'irieni paapaya mɨtikwanikɨ, meta kaxie winuyari kanikatu'irieni, 'Itsahaki katiniukwani meta kananu'ieni.
Hikɨ paapaya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Aurawa kenaye'a neniwe, keneneu'itsi.
Kakuwu 'aurawa kaniuyani kani'itseni. Kepauka 'Itsahaki mi'ɨkwixɨ kamixaya, hikɨ Kakaɨyari kaniutawawirieni 'aixɨa miyurienikɨ, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:

content.text: Kakaɨyari waɨkawa wiyeri kematsiheyenɨ'airiwani muyuawitsie mieme,

content: Hikɨ 'Itsahaki yuniwe hetsiemieme Kakaɨyari 'utawawirieku, Kakuwu 'amɨtiwayetɨa 'Etsahu kaninuani rekumieka.
Mɨkɨta katiniukawewieni 'ikwaiya, yupaapa katine'ɨirieni, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Nepaapa, kenanukukeka ketineukwa'i tita nemɨremi. Hikɨ Kakaɨyari keneutawawiri 'aixɨa mɨnetsiyurienikɨ.
Hikɨ 'Itsahaki kanita'iwawiya. —¿Kemɨ'aneta 'ekɨ peputaine? 'Etsahu mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne 'Etsahu neputaine, 'aniwe 'anemɨyumate.

'Itsahaki kaniutimani 'uyɨyɨakatɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —¿Kamɨtsɨ kemɨ'ane pɨyɨanekai xikepaitɨ mɨnerekumi 'itsari mɨnetsi'atɨiri? 'Ekɨ 'akuxi pekanuawekaku, ne nekanikwani naime. Meta Kakaɨyari nekaniutawawirieni hetsiena mieme 'aixɨa nekaniyurieni, mɨkɨri 'aixɨa 'itɨarietɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.

Kepauka 'Etsahu mu'enaxɨ paapaya kemainekai karima kaniutatsuani yuhiwerietɨ, mɨpaɨ yupaapa katiniutahɨawe ha'atɨ: —Ne waɨkawa nepɨmatsiwawirie, nepaapa 'aku, Kakaɨyari keneutawawiri nehetsiemieme neta 'aixɨa mɨnetsiyurienikɨ.
Peru 'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Amuta kaneukuyeixɨani kanetiniu'itaiya, mɨkɨri naime katinepiini tita mɨti'ahetsiemiemetɨkai.

'Etsahu mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ayumieme xɨari Kakuwu xepɨte'iterɨwaxɨ, hikɨri hutarieka kaneniukwamana, matɨari meri kaneniunawairieni kenemɨtimexɨakame, hikɨta 'aixɨa kenemɨ'itɨarienikekai kaneniunawairieni. ¿Pekatiyɨwe Kakaɨyari pemɨtawawirieni 'aixɨa mɨnetsiyurienikɨta ne?

'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Neuxei ne, Kakaɨyari neputawawiri Kakuwu hetsiemieme mɨmati'aitɨakakɨ, nepitawawiri tsiere maremama yunaitɨ memɨte'ita'uximayatsirienikɨ, tɨriku waɨkawa mukaxexeiyanikɨ meta kaxie winuyari. ¿Hikɨ tita netiutawauni 'ahetsiemieme pɨtiumaweri, neniwe 'aku?

Peru 'Etsahu pɨkatihayewakai: —¿Xeimieme xeikɨa petiyɨwekai Kakaɨyari pemɨtawawirieni 'aixɨa xewitɨ xeikɨa mɨ'itɨarienikɨ? Keneutawawiri Kakaɨyari neta 'aixɨa mɨnetsiyurienikɨ. Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka tawarita kaniutatsuani karima.
Hikɨ 'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe:
Kakuwu kemɨtiuyuta'unaxɨ

Mana mɨtiyetɨa, 'Etsahu Kakuwu kanihekakaitɨni paapaya Kakaɨyari mutawawirikɨ hetsiena mieme 'aixɨa miyuriekakɨ. 'Etsahu mɨpaɨ katiniku'eriwakaitɨni: «'Arikutari kwitɨwa pɨmɨni nepaapa mɨyuke, nemuta Kakuwu nepɨmieni».
Hikɨ kepauka Xeweka mɨretima 'Etsahu kemɨtiku'eriwakai, Kakuwu kaniuta'inieni mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei, 'a'iwa 'Etsahu pɨmatsimiemɨkɨ pemɨtinawairikɨ.
'Ayumieme neniwe, keneneu'eni: Keneuyuta'una Karani paitɨ, ne'iwa kie Rawani,
mɨkɨ hetsɨa kenekani kepaukake 'amatsika mɨratɨmaiya ha'atɨ.
Ratɨmaiyayu kepemɨtiuyuri, 'anake niuki nepanunɨ'ani pemamiekɨ. Yanepɨkara'eriwa tietɨtsɨ xeitukaritsie yunaitɨ xemɨneuyukwixɨa.

Hikɨ Xeweka 'Itsahaki mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Neri nepɨkayɨwe 'anemuyeikani 'ikɨ hetitsixi wahamatɨa 'Etsahu 'ɨitamama mepɨnetsihiweritɨa. Xɨkata Kakuwu Heti tewiyari 'utiwitɨni 'ena kiekame Kanani matsi 'aixɨa pɨyɨnikeyu xɨka ne'umɨnike.
